title: xagana cule diini mara
intro: massakaxxa le nabiyyi ummattah fanat gexak numma fanah ken seeca. mango mari wadirih yuduureh giddil, takkay immay qunxa maroyta seeco gacisseh kee sinni sorkocobaxak xagana culen. oson shakki luk aqayyaare lon kee qaran rizqi gorrisaanam dirkisen. ken angoyya sinni kibal wakti sinni qasiir yekke imaanal. Oson miyyak sugeenim?
clues: Nanu qunxa buttak sugneeh, fidin kufrih uddur qibaadah farmo qokolnuh ugutte.
Massakaxxa le nabiyyi yemeeteeh, Yallih gital kataysis akkuk soolaanam nee seece.
farmoyti essere wak miyya kinnim qibaadah qokleenit, nanu gacseh qammaxxaaga sinnim.
Nanu sorkocô baxa maqarrossuh qaraanak obteh tan cakkumuk tan qaffayda esserram dirkisne.
Ni nabiyyi nummaak muuminiin tekkek Yalla nassakaxxem nee kassiise, takkay immay ni rammitle essero kunnabna luk sugte.
Nanu Maryam baxi Isa xaqut xagana cule addah maroh sugne.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
